```cypher
MATCH (evernote:Plugin {component: 'repository_evernote'})
MATCH (evernote)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(category:Category)
MATCH (alternative:Plugin)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(category)
WHERE alternative.component <> evernote.component
WITH alternative, evernote
MATCH (alternative)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
RETURN alternative.component, alternative.name, COLLECT(m.display_name) AS maintainers
LIMIT 100
```
